correction: R44 was a commercial provider-signature inventory, not a complete research-egress inventory. R48 adds fixed and unauthenticated research services that can still receive customer-derived query terms.

perplexity.control_evidence: Public API retention detail was not sufficiently specific in the reviewed official material.

exa.input: AI-scoped decision claim or planned news query
exa.control_evidence: Enterprise ZDR is advertised, but the active account mode is not proved.

brave.input: AI-scoped decision claim, company query or planned news query
brave.control_evidence: Enterprise full-funnel ZDR is advertised, but the active account mode is not proved.

tavily.input: company query or planned news query
tavily.control_evidence: Tavily describes ZDR as core in current product material, while its privacy policy says query data may be used to improve responses unless the contract says otherwise. Contract and account evidence are therefore required.

newsapi.input: AI-scoped claim or planned news query
newsapi.control_evidence: The public privacy notice gives purpose-based retention but no sufficiently precise API-query retention period.

builtwith.control_evidence: The current API documents header authentication and an NOPII response control on the current endpoint. The repository uses an older endpoint, puts the key in the URL and does not request NOPII.

people_data_labs.input: company name on the company-enrichment endpoint
people_data_labs.control_evidence: The reviewed public privacy material did not establish a precise API-query retention mode.

artificial_analysis.input: no customer query; fixed model leaderboard fetch
artificial_analysis.control_evidence: The repository sends only a fixed endpoint request with an account API key.

tranco.control_evidence: No private decision text is required by the route.

gdelt.control_evidence: Public query endpoint; no private-context retention control is proved.

hacker_news_algolia.control_evidence: Public query endpoint; no private-context retention control is proved.

fixed_rss_publishers.input: no customer query; fixed public feed URLs
fixed_rss_publishers.control_evidence: Only ordinary feed requests are made. Publisher logs remain outside Mindmaker control.

minimisation_gate: never send a leader name, email, verbatim interview answer or raw Brain memory to a research provider
never send a raw decision claim when a bounded public search question can answer it
company enrichment may send only an already-public company name or bare domain
fixed public fetches must remain independent of customer context
log a digest of the bounded query and its purpose, never the raw private source text
fail closed when a route needs more private context than its standing permits
next_gate: Design the provider-receipt registry and a deterministic query-minimisation adapter before any new runtime uses these routes.
not_authorized: changing live queries or provider selection
